intent.instructions: The message was typed by a school administrator in the chat of a Moroccan school management dashboard. It can be English, French, Spanish, Modern Standard Arabic or Moroccan Darija in Arabic or Latin script, or a mix. Which kind of request is it?

criteria.small_talk: Only a greeting, thanks, goodbye, or a question about what the assistant can do. No request for school data.
criteria.student_count: Asks only how many students are enrolled in the whole school this year: one number, not a list of students, with no filter by class, section, gender, status, date or anything else.
criteria.teacher_count: Asks only how many teachers the whole school has: one number, not a list or names of teachers, with no filter by subject, class or anything else.
criteria.student_and_teacher_count: Asks for both the total number of students and the total number of teachers, with no filter.
criteria.class_list: Asks to list or name the school's classes, with no filter and no question about their students, teachers or timetable.
criteria.attendance_today: Asks to see today's attendance for the whole school (who is present or absent today), with no class, student or other date, and not a number to compute.
criteria.upcoming_exams: Asks which exams are coming up or when the next exam is, for the whole school, with no class, subject or student filter.
criteria.write_request: Asks the assistant to create, add, record, mark, change, publish, send or delete something now, for example to record a student as absent or present today, including short Darija commands. Asking how to do it oneself is not this.
criteria.needs_llm: Anything else: a question with a filter or qualifier (a class, a student, a name, a gender, a past or other date, last year, a number to compute), a list of teachers or students, grades, fees, payments, timetables, how-to questions, a short follow-up that starts with "and" (et, y, و, w) or needs an earlier message, unclear requests and topics unrelated to the school.

is_write.instructions: The message was typed by a school administrator in the chat of a Moroccan school management dashboard. It can be English, French, Spanish, Modern Standard Arabic or Moroccan Darija in Arabic or Latin script, or a mix. Does it ask the assistant itself to create, add, record, mark, change, publish or delete data? Classify the requested effect on stored school data, not imperative tone. A command to display, read, list, count or explain existing information is read-only. Quoted examples, negated changes and instructions about doing something oneself are not requests to execute a change. Use the operation and its object: showing an attendance register is different from recording an absence.

criteria.true: The assistant is asked to persist a change now: create, update, record, mark, delete, publish or send. Examples: "enregistre cet élève absent", "سجل غياب التلميذ", "سجل هاد التلميذ غايب", "sjjel tilmid ghayb", "zid tilmid jdid", "beddel smit section". Do not treat a polite wording, question form or incomplete target details as read-only when a data-changing operation is requested.
criteria.false: No stored-data change is requested: show, list or count existing data, explain how, greet, or ask a follow-up that only requests existing information. Examples: "montre le registre de présence", "اعرض سجل الحضور", "وريني سجل الحضور", "werrini sijillat 7odour", "bghit jouj a3dad dyal tlamid w l asatida", "kan9elleb 3la mjmo3 tlamid", "3tini smiyat l a9sam", "kifach nsjjel lghiyab bo7di". Words such as bghit (want), 3tini (give me) and werrini (show me) do not by themselves request a mutation.

continuation.note: Earlier unknown costs remain reserved, not settled as zero. Explicit continuation does not retry earlier failures or prove provider availability. Allowances are cumulative client stops, not billing caps.

criteria: Complete 96 attempts with valid decisions and cost metadata
Fewer than nine false write scores, zero false-negative write scores
Zero wrong accepted choices against frozen provisional labels
At least 57 language-eligible accepted choices and more than six accepted Arabizi choices
Warm classifier p95 at most 500 ms; no rendered-answer latency claim
limits: Historical sequential v3/v4 comparison, not randomized/interleaved
Same spent assistant development questions, linked families and provisional labels
Only eight writes/two families per style; no native authors/reviews
Candidate remains default-off and v3 remains probe default even if dev criteria pass
No additional requests follow completion or a budget/rate-limit/unknown-cost stop
